bundle.shortDescription: Collect thinking traces, responses and preference pairs from language models.
bundle.longDescription: Stellarator runs prompts through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, keeps each prompt with the model's thinking trace and final response, and exports SFT or preference datasets.
